Information on crate labels at the skyport
The desk wrote this for visitors

Crate Labels and Check-In Guidance

At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk helps travelers keep pet paperwork and crate details in good order before departure. Clear labels make the handoff smoother, help handlers move calmly, and support a safe trip through the skyport.

When you prepare a crate, place the traveler name, the pet name, and the destination details where they are easy to see. Use plain, sturdy labels that stay in place and do not peel in damp weather. If a crate already has old labels or tags, remove them so there is no confusion during loading.

Keep the writing easy to read and avoid covering vents, latches, or inspection areas. Handlers need a quick view of the crate from several sides, and a clean label helps them check it without delay. If a pet needs special care, let the desk know ahead of departure so the team can note it on the handling sheet.

For safety, the desk also reviews common hazards such as loose ties, damaged fasteners, and labels that can fall off in transit. The aim is simple: protect the animal, reduce handling stress, and keep the process steady for everyone involved. Our staff uses calm, humane methods around animals and gives clear guidance before departure so travelers feel prepared.

If you are traveling with a pet like Fluffy, bring the crate early enough to allow a careful check. That gives the team time to confirm the label, review the paperwork, and answer any last-minute concerns without rushing.

If you need more help, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk at the skyport.
